title: The Europan Crewman's Primer
description: A practical, grimly atmospheric in-universe field manual for submarine crews operating beneath Europa's ice. The reference emphasizes professional conduct, closed-loop communication, weapons safety, engineering discipline, medical biosecurity, exterior operations, logistics, emergency priorities, crew psychology, and institutional memory.
editorialVoice: Professional, direct, dryly humorous, and written as if accumulated from preventable disasters.
disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made campaign material. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the creators or publishers of Barotrauma.
contentRules: Original prose and campaign doctrine only; do not copy proprietary game text or assets.
Separate harmless eccentricity from conduct that creates an operational hazard.
Treat infection, sabotage, and weapons use as evidence-driven safety matters rather than excuses for collective punishment.
Preserve the rule that a shooter does not fire through a crew member's occupied space.
